dateline: BTS closes its two-night Soldier Field stand in Chicago (Aug 28) with a 32-song set whose surprise song, '134340,' hadn't been performed live since 2019 — capping a week that included a fan-organized trivia night at Replay Lincoln Park (Aug 25) and the Aug 27 'BTS Day' Night 1 opener. The ARIRANG World Tour's North American run now turns to SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6).
heroHeadline: Day 4,825: BTS Closes Chicago Stand With '134340,' First Since 2019
heroSubtitle: August 29, 2026 is Day 4,825 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS closed its two-night Soldier Field stand in Chicago on Aug 28 with a 32-song, two-act-plus-encore set under Illinois's 'BTS Day' proclamation — the surprise song, '134340,' had not been performed live since 2019, and the set closed with 'Butter,' 'Dynamite,' and 'Mikrokosmos.' The Chicago Sun-Times called the stand evidence of the group's 'version 2.0' evolution. Earlier in the week (Aug 25), Chicago-area ARMY held a BTS trivia night at Replay in Lincoln Park ahead of the shows. Chicago was among the final North American ARIRANG World Tour dates before the tour moves to SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6).
